properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued September 14 at 6:58PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
At 658 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 23
miles northwest of Nucla, or 28 miles northeast of La Sal, moving
east at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph and half inch hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

This storm will remain over mainly rural areas of southern Mesa
County.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 14 at 6:48PM MDT until September 14 at 8:15PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
FFWGJT

The National Weather Service in Grand Junction has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southern Archuleta County in southwestern Colorado...

* Until 815 PM MDT.

* At 648 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Chromo, Juanita, Gato, Pagosa Junction and Arboles.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 14 at 6:47PM MDT until September 14 at 8:00PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
FFWGJT

The National Weather Service in Grand Junction has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
West Central Archuleta County in southwestern Colorado...
Southeastern La Plata County in southwestern Colorado...

* Until 800 PM MDT.

* At 647 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Bayfield, Ignacio, Oxford, Falfa, Bondad, Chimney Rock and
Lonetree.

This includes the following streams and drainages...
San Juan River, Beaver Creek, Heflin Creek, Indian Creek, Hayden
Creek, Salt Creek, West Fork Devil Creek, Animas River, Cat Creek,
Dry Creek, Rock Creek, Florida River, Ignacio Creek, Dudley Creek,
Sheep Creek, Pinos River, Los, Piedra River, Elk Creek, Round
Meadow Creek, Squaw Creek, Spring Creek, Devil Creek, Stollsteimer
Creek, Archuleta Creek, Yellowjacket Creek, Crowbar Creek, Ute
Creek and Freeman Creek.
